info.title: Aion API
info.description: Aion Learning Management System — REST API. Generated from the same Zod schemas that validate every request. See `docs/API.md` for how this document is produced.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase-issued JWT. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Verify via `supabase.auth.getUser(token)`. `POST /api/v1/payments/stripe/webhook` is the single exception — it authenticates by Stripe signature header, not a bearer token.

post.summary: Upload an image or document to Cloudinary
post.description: Accepts `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part, an optional `folder` and an optional `kind=document` which widens the allowlist to PDF/Word/text and routes to Cloudinary's raw pipeline. No request schema is declared deliberately: the handler reads the body with `parseBody()`, and a validator here would consume the stream first. Declared bytes are checked against the file's magic-number signature before upload.
